findings.evidence: Cache hits wrote a chat_session and a chat_message with no quota charge and no per-student cap; RateLimitFilter limits per tenant, not per student, so a student could replay a cached question with fresh session ids.
findings.why_it_matters: Unbounded free writes grow the tables and sidestep the 20 per day product limit.
findings.resolution: Each student has a daily cap on cache-served answers (chat.ai.max-cache-hits-per-day, default 100, validated >= 1, CHAT_AI_MAX_CACHE_HITS_PER_DAY); past the cap the question takes the charged path. Covered by ChatServiceCacheCapTest, ChatServiceCacheCapPostgresTest, ChatSessionServiceCacheHitsPostgresTest and ChatPropertiesCacheCapTest.

findings.evidence: ChatSessionService holds unused sessions and messages repositories; ChatAnswerCacheService holds an unused repository; ChatService wraps calls that already never throw.
findings.why_it_matters: Dead constructor dependencies and unreachable catches mislead readers.
findings.required_action: Remove them once the locked Phase 3 tests allow it.
findings.resolution: Accepted debt: the constructors are pinned by the locked TDD tests and the defensive catches are required by ChatServiceFailureTest.

findings.evidence: cacheStoreFailed() is never called; providerFailed is not called for unexpected RuntimeException; quotaRefunded counts a refund even when refundQuietly swallowed a failure.
findings.why_it_matters: Some failures are invisible on dashboards and the refunded counter can overstate real refunds.
findings.required_action: Wire the counters when the locked tests can change.
findings.resolution: Accepted debt; the limits are documented in ops-runbook.md (subtract chat.quota.refund.failed, read FAILED rows for unexpected provider errors).

findings.evidence: No size bound on the JSON string before the service validates it; a NUL character used to pass validation and fail the insert after the provider call.
findings.why_it_matters: A 503 for what should be a 400, and an uncapped body is parsed before rejection (repo-wide, no global body limit).
findings.required_action: Add a global request-body limit repo-wide.
findings.resolution: Partly fixed: ChatSendValidator rejects control characters other than newline, carriage return and tab and never echoes values. The DTO @Size cap was tried and removed because it contradicts the locked ChatDtoShapeTest; the missing body limit stays as accepted debt.

findings.evidence: These two classes logged the raw exception (message and stack) on a swallowed failure; a database error can quote the failing row.
findings.why_it_matters: The cache row holds an AI answer that may quote a student's essay.
findings.resolution: Fixed after the review: ChatErrors is now public and both classes log ChatErrors.describe(ex) (exception type names and SQLState only). Remaining gap: ChatServiceLogSafetyTest mocks these two collaborators, so the real log lines have no dedicated test.

findings.evidence: A RowMapper builds a partially hydrated ChatMessage entity (7 of about 18 fields) that crosses the service and controller boundaries.
findings.why_it_matters: A half-populated entity can be mistaken for a full row.
findings.resolution: Accepted debt: the return types are pinned by the locked tests.

findings.evidence: service.session and service.quota import service.ChatObservability while service imports them back; ChatQuotaExceededException imports service.quota.ChatQuotaSnapshot.
findings.why_it_matters: A package cycle blurs the layering; no architecture test catches it.
findings.required_action: Move ChatObservability and ChatQuotaSnapshot to a neutral package.
findings.resolution: Accepted debt: package locations are pinned by the locked tests.

findings.evidence: ChatService was 297 of 300 lines and mixed validation, entity assembly and orchestration.
findings.why_it_matters: Any further change would break the size limit and the refund invariants were harder to audit.
findings.resolution: Validation moved to ChatSendValidator, row assembly to ChatMessageFactory, log sanitising to ChatErrors; ChatService is 240 lines.

findings.evidence: Language and status literals were repeated inline in the service, prompts and SQL.
findings.resolution: ChatConstants.LANGUAGE_EN/LANGUAGE_VI and STATUS_* are used by the validator, prompts and SQL; guarded by ChatLanguageConstantsTest and ChatStatusSqlTest.

findings.evidence: The cache key has no model name and expires_at is never written.
findings.why_it_matters: A model change retires entries only if ChatPrompts.VERSION is bumped by hand.
findings.required_action: Bump ChatPrompts.VERSION on model or prompt changes (recorded in ops-runbook.md).

findings.evidence: The per-student lock, the global semaphore and the daily cache-hit cap hold per instance only.
findings.why_it_matters: With several instances these limits become soft; the quota itself is database-backed and correct.
findings.required_action: Document the single-instance assumption (done in ops-runbook.md, section 3).
findings.resolution: Documented in code and in the runbook.
